testsuite.name: com.opensource.docgrid.domain.permission.integration.PermissionSavedResponseVerificationTest

testcase.name: Saved answer and conversation must exclude revoked content
First model request after revocation must exclude an earlier queued source
A new allowed search must not reuse a revoked answer in model history
Legacy or malformed provenance must withhold answers and history
Revoked transitive history sources must suppress a later answer citing only allowed documents
Timeout fallback must use current permitted sources instead of the old top result
A queued job with no readable source must finish without a model request
